correctness.rationale: Reconstructed RESULT.md §§1–4. Centering the two triangular weights gives the convolution in (1): any nonzero summand has |mB| ≤ (n+1)(m−1), hence |B| ≤ n, so extending the range adds nothing. The support bounds give |j| ≤ k, and A=m−1 gives a positive endpoint summand at j=k since k<m; reflection supplies the other endpoint. The normalized coefficients are whole-line trapezoidal sums of compact tent products. Off their finitely many corners the per-cell error is O_k(m^−3); at corners Lipschitz continuity gives O_k(m^−2). The three tent integrals give normalized coefficients 1 at |j|=k, 6(k−|j|) for 0<|j|<k, and 6k−2 at j=0, exactly the asserted factorization. For (4), use V=nA+mB and j=(kA+V)/m; the congruence indicator yields two nonnegative Fejér factors. The first factors sum to m² by coprimality, and the second factors have lower bound sin²(θ/2), with θ=0 handled directly. Rouché gives one root in each simple-root cluster at scale m^−2 and two in each double-root cluster at scale m^−1. Conjugate reciprocation preserves each unit-point cluster for large m (use fixed disjoint neighborhoods and then the shrinking estimates); no roots are on the circle, so the two roots in each such cluster are distinct, one inside and one outside. The slice is realizable for 0<|z|<1 by taking the two points with equal coordinate moduli sqrt(|z|) and appropriate phases, and the denominator there does not vanish. No uniformity in growing k is inferred. CHECK.py and requirements.txt were inspected, not run; the reported finite tests in VERIFICATION.md are not inputs to the analytical proof.
